title: Quiet Geometry
colours: dusty rose, sand and slate grey
description: Soft edged rectangles of dusty rose, sand and slate grey float on a warm ground. The acrylic is thin enough in places to let earlier layers show through.
summary: A calm colour field painting where a few soft rectangles seem to drift and settle.

title: Red Interval
colours: deep red on pale ochre
description: A single deep red band crosses a pale ochre ground from edge to edge. The band is brushed in many thin layers, so its edges glow and soften.
summary: One red band on a pale field, simple and steady.

title: Tidal Marks
colours: charcoal, indigo and wet sand
description: Sweeping strokes rise and fall across the canvas like waves on a shore. Real sand mixed into the paint gives the surface the rough feel of a wet beach.
summary: An energetic abstract of waves and sand in charcoal and indigo.

title: Harmattan
colours: dusty orange, grey and bone white
description: Veils of dusty orange and grey are scraped back with a palette knife. The painting recalls the dry season haze when dust hangs in the air.
summary: A dramatic abstract of dust and light in the harmattan season.

title: Blue Ascension
colours: deep navy rising to pale sky blue
description: Soft vertical bands of blue grow lighter from deep navy to pale sky blue. The thick oil paint keeps every brush mark visible.
summary: A calm painting where blue slowly lifts into light.

title: Threshold
colours: mustard, teal and cream
description: A simple doorway is built from flat blocks of mustard, teal and cream. The crisp gouache edges make the shape feel quiet and exact.
summary: A calm geometric painting of a doorway made from flat colour.

title: Night Market
colours: near black with flashes of yellow and magenta
description: Dense dark marks are broken by sudden flashes of yellow and magenta. It feels like walking through a crowded market at night, lit by small lamps.
summary: An energetic abstract of lamps and movement in a night market.

title: Cobalt Fold
colours: cobalt blue and chalk white
description: Crisp planes of cobalt blue and chalk white fold into each other like a creased sheet of paper. The flat gouache gives every facet a clean edge.
summary: A calm geometric study of folded blue planes.

title: Ember Field
colours: glowing orange and red over black
description: Small glowing flecks of orange and red are scattered across a black field. Up close the thick oil paint stands out from the surface like real embers.
summary: A dramatic abstract of embers glowing in the dark.

title: Small Mercies
colours: sage green, blush pink and cream
description: Three soft edged squares of sage green, blush pink and cream are stacked loosely on a pale ground. The oil is brushed on in slow, gentle layers.
summary: A tender colour field of three stacked squares.

title: Morning on the River
colours: soft greens, silver and pale gold
description: A peaceful morning on the river, with mist rising above the water and soft sunlight filtering through the willows. Short broken strokes catch the silver and gold of the early light.
summary: This painting captures the quiet beauty of a morning on the river, with soft light, mist and reflections creating a sense of calm and peace.

title: Hills After Rain
colours: fresh greens and soft greys
description: Rolling green hills lie under grey clouds that are just starting to clear. Soft watercolour washes let the white of the paper show through as light.
summary: A calm landscape of hills and clearing skies after rain.

title: The Long Road Home
colours: warm orange, red earth and violet
description: A red earth road runs between tall grass towards a low evening sun. Warm orange and violet strokes make the whole scene glow.
summary: A tender landscape of a red earth road at sunset.

title: Winter Lake
colours: pale blue, white and grey
description: A frozen lake lies still beneath bare birch trees and a low winter sun. Pale blue and grey washes keep the scene cold and quiet.
summary: A calm winter scene of ice, birches and low sun.

title: Village at Dusk
colours: warm roof tones against blue shadow
description: Tin roofs catch the last warm light while blue shadows gather between the houses. The thick oil strokes give the village a gentle, settled feeling.
summary: A calm village scene at the end of the day.

title: Harbour Haze
colours: muted greys with small touches of red
description: Fishing boats rest in a hazy harbour under the noon light. Muted greys fill the scene, with small touches of red on the hulls.
summary: A calm harbour scene in soft grey haze.

title: Rice Terraces
colours: grey ink washes on white paper
description: Stepped rice terraces curve down a hillside in layers of grey ink. Each wash is lighter than the one before, so the hill seems to fade into the distance.
summary: A calm ink landscape of terraced fields.

title: Evening on the Lagoon
colours: orange sky reflected in still water with dark canoes
description: Two dark canoes rest on a still lagoon that mirrors the orange evening sky. The reflections are painted in short, broken strokes of thick oil.
summary: A calm lagoon at sunset, with canoes and their reflections.

title: Storm Coming
colours: dark slate clouds over a single strip of gold light
description: A wall of dark slate cloud moves over flat farmland. One strip of field is still lit in gold before the storm arrives.
summary: A dramatic landscape of a storm about to break.

title: Fog Over the Valley
colours: layered greys fading into white
description: Mountain ridges fade one behind the other into white mist. The layered grey washes leave large areas of the paper almost empty.
summary: A calm ink painting of ridges disappearing into fog.

title: Peonies in a Blue Jar
colours: rich pinks, a chipped cobalt jar and warm wood
description: Heavy pink peonies spill from a chipped blue jar on a wooden table. Thick oil paint gives the petals real weight and softness.
summary: A joyful still life of peonies in a cobalt jar.

title: White Lilies
colours: white flowers against deep olive
description: Three white lilies stand against a dark olive background. The dark ground makes the petals seem to glow.
summary: A tender still life of white lilies on olive.

title: Plum Blossom
colours: grey ink with small touches of pink
description: A single branch of plum blossom reaches across the paper. Grey ink forms the branch, with small touches of pink for the flowers.
summary: A tender ink painting of one blossoming branch.

title: Hibiscus at Noon
colours: bright red flowers and deep green leaves in hard sunlight
description: Red hibiscus flowers fill the whole canvas in hard midday sunlight. Deep green leaves push the reds even brighter.
summary: A joyful close view of hibiscus in strong sun.

title: Sunflowers Going Over
colours: browning yellows and warm ochre
description: Drooping sunflowers lean out of a tin jug, their petals starting to brown. Warm ochre tones give the scene a late summer sadness.
summary: A melancholic still life of sunflowers past their best.

title: Wild Roses
colours: pale pinks and soft greens with white paper showing
description: Pale wild roses open on a thorny stem. Soft pink and green washes leave much of the white paper showing.
summary: A tender watercolour of wild roses.

title: Lotus at Dawn
colours: grey ink washes with a blush of pink
description: A lotus opens above dark still water. Grey ink washes carry a faint blush of pink in the petals.
summary: A calm ink painting of a lotus at first light.

title: Marigold Garland
colours: bright orange and gold on cream
description: A garland of orange marigolds loops across a cream ground. Flat gouache colour and crisp edges give it the feel of a festival decoration.
summary: A joyful folk painting of a marigold garland.

title: Bougainvillea Wall
colours: magenta flowers, white wall and a hot sky
description: Magenta bougainvillea spills over a sunlit white wall under a hot sky. The acrylic is laid on in bold, confident strokes.
summary: A joyful painting of bougainvillea in bright sun.

title: Dahlias in September
colours: dark red and coral against stoneware grey
description: Dark red and coral dahlias crowd a stoneware vase. The grey of the vase cools the rich warm petals.
summary: A tender still life of dahlias at the end of summer.

title: Heron in the Reeds
colours: grey blues and reed greens
description: A grey heron stands perfectly still among tall reeds at the water's edge. Cool grey blues and reed greens keep the whole scene hushed.
summary: A calm study of a heron waiting in the reeds.

title: Monsoon Leaves
colours: deep greens with bright rain drops
description: Huge wet banana leaves fill the paper as rain runs down them. Bright drops stand out against the deep greens.
summary: A joyful painting of leaves in monsoon rain.

title: Forest Floor
colours: moss green, rust and dappled gold
description: Moss, ferns and fallen leaves cover a forest floor in dappled light. Rust and gold sit among the soft moss greens.
summary: A calm close view of the forest floor.

title: Koi Pond
colours: orange and white fish under green lily pads
description: Orange and white koi glide under green lily pads. Loose watercolour washes make the water seem to move.
summary: A calm watercolour of koi under lily pads.

title: Baobab at Noon
colours: bleached ochre and a pale hot sky
description: A massive baobab trunk with sparse branches stands in white midday heat. Bleached ochre and a pale hot sky give it a solemn stillness.
summary: A solemn portrait of a baobab in the noon heat.

title: Mangrove Roots
colours: dark greens and black water with green reflections
description: Tangled mangrove roots twist over dark water. Green reflections break up the black surface below.
summary: A dramatic painting of mangrove roots and dark water.

title: Bamboo After Rain
colours: layered grey ink
description: Tall bamboo stems and leaves drip after a passing rain. The grey ink is layered from pale to dark to give depth.
summary: A calm ink painting of bamboo after rain.

title: Egrets at Sunset
colours: white birds over a pink and gold lagoon
description: White egrets lift off a pink and gold lagoon as the sun goes down. Quick strokes of thick oil catch the movement of their wings.
summary: A joyful scene of egrets taking flight at sunset.

title: Mountain Stream
colours: white water, grey stone and dark pine green
description: White water tumbles over grey boulders between dark pines. The paper is left bare for the foam, which makes it sparkle.
summary: An energetic watercolour of a rushing mountain stream.

title: Cranes in Snow
colours: white paper, grey ink and a touch of red on the heads of the cranes
description: Two cranes stand together in falling snow. Grey ink and white paper do most of the work, with a touch of red on each head.
summary: A tender ink painting of two cranes in the snow.

title: Woman Reading by the Window
colours: soft greys and warm window light
description: A woman in a grey dress reads a book by a window. Warm light falls across the page and her hands.
summary: A calm interior of a woman lost in a book.

title: The Drummer
colours: warm ochre and black
description: A drummer is caught in the middle of a beat, his hands blurred with movement. Warm ochre and black strokes carry the rhythm across the canvas.
summary: An energetic figure painting full of rhythm and sound.

title: Market Woman
colours: charcoal greys on warm paper
description: A seated market woman in a head wrap looks straight at the viewer. Charcoal lines and smudges on warm paper give her face strength and calm.
summary: A solemn charcoal portrait of a market woman.

title: Two Sisters
colours: white dresses against soft green and rose
description: Two girls in white dresses sit on a garden bench, one looking away. Soft green and rose pastel surround them like a summer afternoon.
summary: A tender pastel of two sisters in a garden.

title: The Tailor
colours: warm lamplight and deep brown shadow
description: An old tailor bends over his sewing machine under a bare bulb. Warm lamplight meets deep brown shadow all around him.
summary: A calm portrait of a tailor at work.

title: Dancer Resting
colours: pale pinks and greys
description: A young dancer ties her shoe in a quiet rehearsal room. Pale pinks and greys give the moment a soft, private feel.
summary: A tender pastel of a dancer taking a short rest.

title: The Fishermen
colours: dawn greys, wet browns and a pale gold sky
description: Three fishermen haul a heavy net out of the sea at dawn. Wet browns and dawn greys sit under a pale gold sky.
summary: A dramatic scene of fishermen at work in the early light.

title: Self Portrait in Grey
colours: greys with one warm highlight on the cheek
description: A woman looks frankly out of the canvas in a self portrait painted almost entirely in greys. One warm highlight on the cheek brings the face to life.
summary: A melancholic self portrait in shades of grey.

title: Girl in a Yellow Scarf
colours: bright yellow against deep blue
description: A young woman in a bright yellow scarf stands against a deep blue wall. The strong contrast makes the yellow almost shine.
summary: A joyful portrait in bright yellow and deep blue.

title: The Chess Players
colours: warm cafe browns and afternoon light
description: Two old men bend over a chessboard in a cafe. Warm browns and afternoon light fill the room.
summary: A calm scene of a slow game of chess.

title: Annunciation in Gold
colours: gold leaf, lapis blue and soft rose
description: An angel kneels before a young woman in a small room under a gold leaf sky. Fine tempera brushwork and a slightly cracked surface give it the feel of an old panel.
summary: A solemn panel painting of the Annunciation in gold and lapis.

title: Madonna of the Olive Grove
colours: silver olive greens, soft blue and gold
description: A mother holds her child, seated under silver olive trees. Soft blue and touches of gold glow through the cracked panel.
summary: A tender panel painting of mother and child in an olive grove.

title: The Good Shepherd
colours: red earth hills and a dusk sky
description: A shepherd carries a lamb across red earth hills at dusk. The warm hills and fading sky make the journey feel gentle and safe.
summary: A tender painting of a shepherd carrying a lamb home.

title: Pentecost
colours: deep shadow with small bright flames
description: A gathering of people sits in a dark room with small flames above their heads. The bright flames cut sharply through the deep shadow.
summary: A dramatic painting of the flames of Pentecost.

title: Saint Francis and the Birds
colours: soft browns, a pale sky and small dark birds
description: A robed friar stands on a hillside speaking to a flock of small birds. Soft browns and a pale sky keep the scene quiet.
summary: A calm panel painting of Saint Francis with the birds.

title: Nativity at Night
colours: deep darkness with warm light from the child
description: A stable at night is lit only by the light around a newborn child. Deep darkness surrounds the warm glow at the centre.
summary: A solemn nativity lit from within.

title: The Prodigal Son
colours: warm browns and dusty gold
description: A father embraces his kneeling son at a gate. Warm browns and dusty gold give the reunion a soft glow.
summary: A tender painting of the prodigal son coming home.

title: The Flight into Egypt
colours: pale desert sand and dawn rose under gold
description: A family on a donkey crosses a pale desert at dawn. Sand and dawn rose sit under a sky touched with gold.
summary: A calm panel painting of the journey into Egypt.

title: Ruth in the Field
colours: gold barley under a soft evening sky
description: A woman gathers barley in a gold field at evening. The soft sky and warm field make the work look peaceful.
summary: A calm painting of Ruth gathering barley.

title: Jacob's Ladder
colours: night blue with a column of warm light
description: A traveller sleeps on the ground while a ladder of light rises into the clouds. A column of warm light cuts through the night blue sky.
summary: A dramatic painting of Jacob's dream.
